script.problem: A quote isn't the BSB's exact words.

terra.problem: Saying the convert does not come out wiser at all adds a claim the text does not make.
Their rule says an oath by the temple means nothing, not that the temple itself means nothing.
Identifying justice, mercy and faithfulness as the camel muddles the picture: Jesus says they disregard those matters, not swallow them.
The singular address ‘Blind Pharisee’ does not establish that Jesus is speaking to one individual Pharisee.
Referring to the card's claim brings the app into Papa Dorin's explanation.
Referring to what the card says brings the app into Papa Dorin's explanation.
Saying their words testify ‘the other way’ suggests they admit they would have joined in. Jesus says their words testify that they are sons of those who murdered the prophets.
